This copy of rama-dns 0.3.0-alpha.4 comes from the crates.io package built from upstream commit 4733273a10a791762e2b7727850032b0c9b8536d. The upstream MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses are included.

The fork pins the Rama family to its existing alpha API, changes the resolver to Hickory 0.26.3, and adapts the resolver calls in src/hickory.rs. The package can be removed when Codex upgrades its complete Rama integration to a release with patched Hickory and a compatible time dependency.
